policies.title: Sri Lankan ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Grenada's active embassy country schedule says Sri Lanka requires no visa for a visitor entry.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sri Lankan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The live embassy page links the April 2024 schedule; recheck it before travel for changes.
Work, residence, study, diplomatic, official and service passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this finding.

policies.title: Sri Lankan ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy visa schedule lists Sri Lanka in the authorized-visa cohort when the holder does not qualify for the separate third-country-document waiver.
conditions: This is the ordinary Sri Lankan-passport baseline without a qualifying third-country visa or residence document. That separate document-conditioned waiver is not normalized as the baseline.
The authorized visa must be granted before travel; the current source warns that approval may take up to 60 business days.
The cited embassy's personal-appearance and U.S.-ID filing directions may be mission-specific. Use the competent Panamanian mission for an actual application.

policies.title: Sri Lankan ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current MFA table requires a visa for Sri Lankan ordinary passports; its eVisa route is conditional on a separate qualifying visa or residence permit.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Sri Lankan passport holder without the third-country visa or residence permit required for Türkiye's conditional eVisa route.
A qualifying valid Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit may make eVisa available, but that document-conditioned route is not the ordinary-passport baseline.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this finding.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's current MFA table requires a visa for Sri Lankan ordinary passports; eVisa is only available with a separate qualifying third-country visa or residence permit.
